consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: standby attendance and non-entry rescue capability

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: high potential incident during start-up after maintenance on EX-9101

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control STANDBY_ATTENDANCE_AND_RESCUE: the standby attendance and non-entry rescue capability was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the standby attendance and non-entry rescue capability on EX-9101 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in authorising and controlling entry, specifically atmospheric testing and continuous monitoring. EX-9101 (earthmoving fleet) is in service for loading and dozing. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the standby attendance and non-entry rescue capability was in place but did not perform. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 21 December 2024 a high potential incident was recorded on EX-9101 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during start-up after maintenance; kinetic energy held as rotating equipment was not released.
